GemWallet browser API 3.8.0, distributed under the adjacent license.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@gemwallet/api/-/api-3.8.0.tgz
Vendored file: package/umd/gemwallet-api.js (unaltered).
Upstream: https://github.com/GemWallet/gemwallet-extension

The SDK is a browser-to-extension bridge. Its version does not guarantee the
installed extension's XRPL codec supports VaultDeposit, VaultWithdraw or LoanPay.
The application reports signing failures and never substitutes XRP Payments.
